value.body: A production planning and control (PPC) engineer decides what a factory makes, when, and with which machines and materials, so orders ship on time. Manufacturers of auto components, engineering goods and consumer products hire for this role. A typical day involves updating schedules, checking material availability, coordinating with shop-floor, stores and purchase teams, and tracking output.

value.title: How you get in
value.body: Freshers often join manufacturing plants as graduate engineer trainees and are placed in PPC after a rotation, or move in from production roles. Excel skills and an understanding of shop-floor processes help.

value.title: Skills you'll use
items: Re-planning when orders or supplies change

value.title: At a glance
items: Common next roles: PPC manager, supply chain planner, plant operations roles.
The role sits between production, purchase and sales; coordination is most of the job.
Plant-based, often in industrial areas outside city centres.
